releases.name: IFCCAD 2026.44.1 alpha
changes: Optional native Zstd: transport revision **1**, inner CBOR mapping **2**; feature `ifccad-cbor-zstd`, disabled by default.

releases.name: IFCCAD 2026.44.0 alpha
changes: JSON/IFCX: `ifcx_alpha`, IFCCAD `profileVersion = 0.1.0`, experimental import `urn:example:ifccad:0.1.0`; offline profile resolution.
Optional native CBOR + Zstd: transport revision `1`, inner mapping `1`; core feature `ifccad-cbor-zstd`, disabled by default.
`ifccad-2026.44.0-native-source.tar.gz`: standalone native sources, core tests, examples, schemas and per-file inventory.
`ifccad-2026.44.0-native.crate`: the same standalone native package; attached as source, not published to crates.io.
`release-manifest.json`: source identity, format versions, dependency identities and verification record.
`SHA256SUMS`: SHA-256 hashes of the three files above.
